description: Returns a list of attachments for a given commitment change order.

parameters.name: commitment_change_order_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Commitment Change Order.

data.description: Array of commitment change order attachments

id.description: Stringified ProStore file ID of the attachment. Unique within the project. Use it to correlate the attachment with the contract's file records.

name.description: Display file name of the attachment, including its extension. Null when the underlying file has no stored name.

url.description: Time-limited, pre-signed download link for the attachment file. Fetch the file promptly, as the link expires; re-request the attachment to obtain a fresh URL.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment file, used to determine how to render or open it. Null when the content type is unknown.

uuid.description: Globally unique identifier of the attachment file, stable across environments. Null when the file has no assigned UUID.
